a: $45,000 per year stipend, full tuition and fees, and a professional development allowance. Renewable up to 4 years; 12-week practicum at an NNSA lab.
dt: Applications for the 2027-28 class due Tuesday 2027-01-05.
e: US citizens only, senior undergrads or 1st/2nd-year PhD students. Covers nuclear science, HED physics and materials under extreme conditions. The 2026 class had only 4 fellows.
n: DOE NNSA Stewardship Science Graduate Fellowship (SSGF)
